timeout_recovery.resume_first_action: Read CURRENT_STATE/CURRENT_INFLIGHT/pointer; producer is the first missing phase.
timeout_recovery.idempotency_rule: Resume first missing committed phase only.
timeout_recovery.atomic_pointer_update_rule: Cursor/pointer files that must agree should be committed together when connector permits; otherwise update serially and verify.
timeout_recovery.compute_boundary_rule: Official producer must be committed and exact blob verified before bounded compute.
